'''2020 EGP Eric Hunter DS I Want That Map''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Eric Hunter]] at [[2020 Endor Grand Prix]] (Day 1).


== Deck info ==

* '''Player:''' [[Eric Hunter]]
* '''Event:''' [[2020 Endor Grand Prix]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|I Want That Map / And Now You'll Give It To Me|V8-D-iwantthatmap.gif}}
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:Open I Want That Map Hunter DS 2020 EGP.txt |Download]]
* '''Format:''' [[Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
* '''Source:''' [https://www.starwarsccg.org/2020-endor-grand-prix/ PC list]. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20200804023225/https://www.starwarsccg.org/2020-endor-grand-prix/ Internet Archive]
